title: erdify model
description: The framework-neutral model every parser produces and every renderer consumes. Byte-compatible with the output of upstream `erdify --format json` (v0.14.1). Array order is significant: renderers iterate entities, fields, relationships and enum values in the order given.

name.description: Class name. Unique within the model; used as the diagram alias and as a relationship target.

table_name.description: Database table name. Foreign keys resolve against this, not against `name`.

source.description: Which parser produced the entity. Upstream values: sqlmodel, sqlalchemy, django, pydantic, dataclass, sql. Port values: eloquent (a table with an Eloquent model), migration (a Laravel table without a model), jpa, spring-data-jdbc. Renderers ignore it.

is_link_table.description: True for a join table: a composite primary key made entirely of foreign keys, with no other columns (at least two columns).

type.description: Type as written in the source language (e.g. `int`, `str`, `bigint`, `Long`). May be dotted; renderers show the part after the last dot. May be empty when unknown.

foreign_table.description: `table.column` (or just `table`) the foreign key points to. Renderers use the part before the first dot.

index.description: Shown in JSON only, never drawn.

default.description: Default value as source text. Renderers show the part after the last dot (`OrderStatus.PENDING` -> `PENDING`).

attribute.description: Attribute or method name, used as the edge label.
